note: Six questions, scored in the browser. Result keys are style record ids, so every result links to a page that carries its own sources. The weights are this project's, and they are a joke with a map attached.
title: Which donut shop are you?
lede: Six questions. A counter takes your order at the end. Argue with it — arguing is most of the pleasure here.

questions.q: It is 5:40 in the morning. You are…

a.t: already in the car, because the raised ones go first
asleep. Donuts are a 10 a.m. food
at work. Someone else is bringing them
still out from last night
a pink box, and you did not notice until just now
a white box with a logo
a paper bag going translucent in your lap
whatever they had. You are eating it in the shop
Raised. Light, glazed, hot, gone
Cake. It holds up to coffee and it tastes of something
Both, and I will be judging whether they can run both
Neither. No hole, filled, and covered in sugar

questions.q: What else is on the board?

a.t: Egg rolls, chow mein, and a warmer
Kolaches. The sausage kind
Breakfast burritos, red or green
A bacon egg and cheese on a roll
a rooftop donut you can see from the freeway
a franchise name nobody in the family chose
lit, and it means they are frying right now
hand-lettered, and the prices are taped over older prices

questions.q: The day you would not miss:

a.t: Fat Tuesday, and I know how many I am allowed
The first cold morning in October
Any day. That is the point of a donut
Whenever the malasada wagon is out

socal-pink-box.title: The pink box shop
socal-pink-box.say: Strip mall, both doughs, one family, open before five. Egg rolls in the warmer. You have opinions about buttermilk bars and you are right to.

southern-hot-now.title: The hot light
southern-hot-now.say: You want it handed over with the glaze still moving. The sign is the whole marketing plan and it has worked on you since childhood.

new-england-cider.title: The orchard window
new-england-cider.say: Six weeks a year, one machine, cinnamon sugar in a paper bag. You buy a dozen and arrive home with six.

texas-kolache-counter.title: The kolache counter
texas-kolache-counter.say: You call them kolaches, a Czech Texan corrects you, and you both keep eating. The oven runs alongside the kettle.

nyc-bodega-donut.title: The corner counter
nyc-bodega-donut.say: Coffee regular and a bacon egg and cheese. The donut is an afterthought until the day it isn't.

new-mexico-burrito-counter.title: The Southwest burrito counter
new-mexico-burrito-counter.say: Foil-wrapped, one hand on the wheel. Red or green is a real question and the donut is the chaser.

chicago-polish-bakery.title: The Polish bakery counter
chicago-polish-bakery.say: You know which Tuesday it is without checking. There is a limit per customer and you respect it, barely.

pennsylvania-fastnacht.title: Fastnacht Day
pennsylvania-fastnacht.say: Potato dough, square cut, butter or golden syrup on it, ordered a week ahead from a fire hall.

hawaii-malasada.title: The malasada counter
hawaii-malasada.say: No hole, no filling unless you ask, sugar all over your shirt, and you would wait in that line again.

louisiana-beignet.title: The beignet stand
louisiana-beignet.say: Three to an order under a snowbank of sugar, coffee cut with chicory, and you know not to inhale.

bay-area-late-counter.title: The all-night counter
bay-area-late-counter.say: Two in the morning, fluorescent light, and the only other people awake. The donut is incidental and it is also perfect.

tulsa-mix-shop.title: The mix-and-sign shop
tulsa-mix-shop.say: Franchise name, family inside, flour from Tulsa. You can spot the difference and most people can't.

novelty-donut-shop.title: The novelty shop
novelty-donut-shop.say: You are here for the photograph and you will eat it anyway. Somebody put bacon on a maple bar and you respect the nerve.

delta-grocery-counter.title: The Delta grocery counter
delta-grocery-counter.say: A store first, a fryer second, and everything hot behind the same glass. Nobody there thinks that is unusual.
